closure_rules: Every core requirement ID from REQ-01 through REQ-96 must appear exactly once.
Blueprint coverage means an authoritative contract and verification path exist; it does not mean a child project has implemented or passed the requirement.
Child pass claims require project-specific evidence under the active assurance, traceability, release and governance contracts.
Adding a new normative core requirement beyond REQ-96 requires a planned protocol release and migration entry.
Commercial launch, external deployment, account configuration and future paid tiers remain separate productization/runtime evidence and do not change blueprint closure.
